impact.text: Per-pool permanent DoS of quote reward claims (until a migration/upgrade).

precondition_sources.text: The pool exists and has totalShares > 0.
The attacker deploys fakeToken and approves the Distributor to spend it.

intent_sources.text: Accounting and transfers must use the canonical quote asset rather than an untrusted caller-supplied quoteAsset.
